# KLYVEN — Full Site Text

KLYVEN — Engineering Tomorrow.

## Mission

KLYVEN is founded on the conviction that software should be built to last — fast, intelligent, and open. KLYVEN builds and ships real products — and publishes the research behind them, in the open. Its model is a mix of free, open-source tools and premium commercial products.

Founded by Naman Sharma and Ayush Mishra in 2026. Naman drives the vision for AI-native platforms and real-time systems. Ayush focuses on products, operating systems, and experiences built for the future.

## Services

### Custom Software
We engineer bespoke applications, platforms, and infrastructure tailored to your vision. From concept to deployment, we build what matters.

### OS & Infrastructure
Operating systems, low-level tooling, and cloud-native infrastructure — secure by design.

### Software Built for Schools
KLYVEN custom-builds software for schools and institutions — from the systems that run your campus to the tools your teachers and students use every day. Process: consult, design, build, deploy, support.

## Products

### Nexcarto — Everyday essentials, delivered local
Status: live · Price: paid
Local delivery that connects neighborhoods with nearby shops and services — groceries, food, clothing, medicine, and more. Community-first and built for what you need, when you need it. Nexcarto is a next-generation geospatial platform.

### Pikoo OS — Your personal AI operating system
Status: coming soon · Price: paid
A ground-up personalized AI operating system. Adaptive, intelligent, and built for the next generation of human-computer interaction. An OS that learns from you, adapts to your workflow, and puts AI-driven productivity at the core of every interaction.

### Klyven Tools — Open-source for everyone
Status: free · Price: free
A collection of free, open-source tools, libraries, and frameworks for developers, researchers, and builders. MIT-licensed and community-driven.

## Research

KLYVEN publishes the research behind its products in the open. Highlight: Project Sparrow — AI at 4GB scale, large memory AI that runs on dramatically lower hardware requirements. Repository: https://github.com/namanstudy90-lab/Project-Sparrow/tree/master/4GB-AI

## About KLYVEN

KLYVEN builds and ships real products — and publishes the research behind them, in the open. From local delivery (Nexcarto) to AI-native platforms (Pikoo OS) to open-source tools (Klyven Tools), KLYVEN's founders Naman Sharma and Ayush Mishra build and ship real products and publish the research behind them, in the open.
